name: seedlatch-web
description: Frontend for the Seedlatch exposure checker. Build-time dependencies only — nothing third-party is served to the browser.

scripts.//build: Deliberately NOT minified, and shipped with a sourcemap. See docs/toolchain.md: the JS toolchain is prebuilt binaries, so readability is what makes injection detectable without reproducing it. Requires web/pkg from wasm-pack.
scripts.//smoke: Bundles the guard alone, so CI exercises a real esbuild run against real wasm-pack glue before main.ts exists. Delete once build covers it.
